verdict_reason: The query is correct and well covered by AddressRepositoryIT and AddressSearchIT, but the roles clause is written twice, once for the filter and once for the search term.

todos.issue: The rule 'an address holds any of these roles' is written twice as the same Mongo clause: Criteria.where("roles").in(criteria.roles()) for the role filter (line 39) and Criteria.where("roles").in(roles) for the HoldingAnyRole search term (line 58). A change to how roles are matched (field name, all-of vs any-of) has to be made in both places.
todos.fix: Must: one function in AddressListQueryImpl owns the 'holds any of these roles' clause, and both the role filter and the HoldingAnyRole case call it. One way: extract private static Criteria holdingAnyOf(List<AddressRole> roles) { return Criteria.where("roles").in(roles); } and use it at lines 39 and 58.
